mono.purpose: Ids, digests, timestamps, routes, stamps — everything verifiable.

shadows.name: overlay-lift
shadows.purpose: Floating overlays only (dialog, command palette, principal menu); the maximum permitted shadow.

shadows.name: active-marker

components.name: Consequential Button
components.description: Solid rust fill reserved for irreversible acts and New ChangeSet.
components.css: .ds-btn-cx { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:40px; padding:0 16px; border:none; border-radius:4px; background:var(--color-consequential-600); color:var(--color-paper-25); font-family:'Hanken Grotesk Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-cx:hover { background:var(--color-consequential-700); } .ds-btn-cx:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-ruling-600); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-cx:active { background:var(--color-consequential-700); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-cx { transition:none; } }

components.name: Rubber Stamp
components.description: Status verdict as a double-ring stamp pill; tones seal/vermilion/amber/ruling carry all status ink. Shown here in seal tone.
components.css: .ds-stamp { position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; transform:rotate(-1deg); border-radius:9999px; border:1.5px solid currentColor; padding:1px 10px; font-family:'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size:11px; font-weight:500; line-height:22px; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-stamp::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:2.5px; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid currentColor; pointer-events:none; } .ds-stamp-seal { border-color:var(--color-seal-700); background:var(--color-seal-50); color:var(--color-seal-700); }

components.name: Ruled Underline Input
components.description: Boxless field drawn as a ledger rule; focus darkens the underline to prussian focus ink.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; background:transparent; border:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-ruling-300); border-radius:0; padding:8px 2px; font-family:'Hanken Grotesk Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:14px; color:var(--color-ink-900); transition:border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--color-ink-500); } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-bottom-color:var(--color-ruling-600); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-bottom-color:var(--color-ruling-600); box-shadow:0 1px 0 0 var(--color-ruling-600); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-input { transition:none; } }

narrative.overview:
The console is a notarial register, not an admin dashboard. Every row is an entry that will never change, and the interface's only chrome is the ledger's own ruling: faded prussian hairlines on a cool laid-paper ground. Iron-gall ink carries the writing; verdicts are struck as rubber stamps in their own ink; a single rust-colored consequential ink is reserved for the acts that can never be undone. It refuses the treeview-and-modal enterprise CMS: no nested boxes, no drop-shadow furniture, no decorative color.

Density is ledger-dense but breathing — 44px entry rows, tabular numerals, authority columns always visible — because the reader is verifying, not browsing. Identifiers are the world's verifiable core: UUIDv7 ids, BLAKE3 digests, and timestamps render in mono, truncated digest-style and copyable, never broken mid-identifier. Hierarchy comes from three voices only: grotesk prose, mono identifiers, small-caps labels. The laid-paper texture ships as a flat ground — the build omits physicality rather than faking it, and stamps are typographic double rings with no bevel or embossing.
keyCharacteristics: Flat laid-paper ground (paper-50) with a cool green cast; panels one step brighter (paper-25)
1px prussian hairlines (ruling-200) as the only chrome; zero shadows at rest
Status ink appears exclusively inside stamp-shaped verdicts (and the lifecycle rail's station marks)
One reserved consequential rust for irreversible actions and the register's single primary action
Mono for everything verifiable; small-caps tracked labels for everything structural
Micro-motion only: 150ms color fades, disabled entirely under prefers-reduced-motion

rules.name: The Hairline Chrome Rule
rules.body: Every border in the system is 1px ruling-200. Drop shadows exist only under floating overlays (dialogs, command palette, menus) at shadow-lg maximum, always over an ink-950/40 scrim.

rules.name: The Stamp Ink Rule
rules.body: Seal, vermilion, and amber appear only inside stamp-shaped verdicts (Stamp, FindingCard) — and, as the one documented exception, as the lifecycle rail's station dots and rejection cross, where they carry progress semantics. Status ink never colors links, headings, backgrounds, or prose.

rules.name: The Consequential Ink Rule
rules.body: consequential-600 marks exactly the acts that cannot be undone plus the register's primary action. If an action can be repeated safely, it does not get this ink.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Text is either grotesk prose, mono identifier, or a small-caps tracked label. Nothing else — no serif, no display face, no italic emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; nothing casts a shadow onto the ledger. If an element floats above the page it takes the scrim and the one permitted shadow; otherwise it earns depth from paper tone alone.

rules.name: The Quiet Ledger Rule
rules.body: Nothing moves while the user reads. Transitions are 150ms ease-out color fades (within the 120–200ms budget) on interactive elements only, each paired with motion-reduce:transition-none; the sole animation is the loading skeleton's pulse.

dos: Do draw all structure with 1px ruling-200 hairlines and earn hierarchy from spacing and type, not boxes.
Do render every status through Stamp with stampToneForStatus; new statuses join the map, never bypass it.
Do reserve consequential-600 for Approve, Commit, Release, Revoke, and New ChangeSet.
Do set every id, digest, and timestamp in Spline Sans Mono; truncate digests 10…8 and offer copy.
Do keep identifiers unbroken — nowrap with ellipsis, digest-style.
Do use tabular numerals for all aligned figures.
Do gate every transition at 150ms color-only with motion-reduce:transition-none.
Do mark synthetic records visibly (SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA chip beside the workspace name).
donts: Don't add drop shadows outside dialogs, the palette, and menus — depth is paper tone and hairlines.
Don't nest bordered boxes; panels don't go inside panels.
Don't invent color families, and never let seal/vermilion/amber decorate non-status UI.
Don't box inputs — fields are ruled underlines.
Don't fake physicality (no bevels, embossing, or paper texture images); the stamp is typographic.
Don't exceed the 24px title size or introduce new type voices.
